description: Binary interaction parameters (kij) for SRK EOS mixing rules. Symmetric matrix: kij = kji. Diagonal = 0.
source: Fitted to DWSIM SRK results + Souers VLE data; HT-DT pair estimated via combining rule

uncertainty.notes: H2-D2 best characterized (Souers data); heteronuclear pairs (HT, DT) have highest uncertainty. kij values are small because all species are similar (same LJ family).
